authority_note: Plan section 12 item 7 (run one pure-MSE on the first external batch once the quality gate has passed). The gate is READY (submission_readiness_gate_2026-10-02.json), the host is idle, and this record is committed before any run is started.
purpose: Test whether the internal pure-MSE null replicates on the two external candidates: does removing the pathway-score and pathway-delta losses (both weights 0.0) change the population extrapolation endpoint, for better or worse, on GSE148794 and GSE149622?
base_protocol: artifacts/reports/external_phase3_preregistration.json (training entry point, hyperparameters, checkpoint selection, endpoint metric, failure policy unchanged)

seed_rule.rationale: The same three seeds as the internal pure-MSE contrast and the phase-2 full arm, so the comparison is paired per seed on identical data, protocol and endpoint; no new seeds are introduced for this arm.

analysis_plan.contrast: Per accession and endpoint, paired per-seed difference pure_mse minus full (both arms from tagged artifacts with matching provenance), mean/SD, two-sided and one-sided t intervals with df=2 (exploratory), written to artifacts/reports/external_pure_mse_contrast.json
analysis_plan.reporting: Every endpoint is reported regardless of sign, including any endpoint where pure-MSE is nominally better or worse; the 5-seed full-arm mean is shown as context but the paired test uses the 3 shared seeds
analysis_plan.gru_control: The GRU arm of the same runs is recorded as a secondary control, exactly as the internal pure-MSE record did

decision_rules.if intervals span zero on both accession: The pathway null replicates across systems; the 'optional regularizer' framing extends to the external sets and is recorded in the plan status.
decision_rules.if an interval excludes zero: Report that dataset's direction honestly and mark the pathway-term contribution as dataset-dependent; no endpoint is dropped and no seed is swapped.
decision_rules.if a run fails: Record the failure as a boundary with exit code and log, do not retry with different seeds, and exclude only the failed run with the failure documented.

explicitly_not_changed: frozen internal primary result and all its artifacts
private publication materials excluded from this release
